title: Bomboclaat Wallahi Creepers
body:
## Bomboclaat Wallahi Creepers

This mod turns all in game creepers into the guy in a newly viral clip who says bomboclaat wallahi as a reaction to a palestinian making jamaican food and makes the creepers explosion sound into the clip's audio. 


###  What the resource pack adds:
- It swaps the creeper texture to resemble the guy saying Bomboclaat Wallahi
- Changes the hissing sound to "bomboclaat wallahi"
- Changes the death sound into the Mi Bombo sound effect
- Changes damage sound into the Pluh meme sound!
